storyline.real: After the last stops Red Bull tell both drivers to hold position, Webber ahead. Vettel passes Webber on lap 46 anyway and wins by 4.3 s.
storyline.headline: Webber keeps Vettel behind and wins in Sepang

mastery.label: Finish second or better on three more stops

hidden.label: Finish second or better with a stint on the hard tyre

eras.briefing: Sepang, 2013. The race started wet on intermediates and the track has dried. Vettel started on pole, Webber fifth, but Webber now leads him by 2.4 s. You run Webber. Bring the car home second or better.
